invariants.rationale: The stream's collect(toList()) operation always produces a non-null list, regardless of input.
If data is non-null, collecting the flatMap always yields a non-negative result list size.
The result is explicitly produced as a List by the collect(toList()) terminal operation.
Regardless of parallelism value, the result list always has a non-negative size.
If data is empty, flatMap returns an empty result; if data is not empty, this does not guarantee a non-empty result, but equality holds when data is empty.
